On April 9th autonomous pro-Palestine activists held a protest outside the NYT building in solidarity with 🇵🇸🇱🇧🇮🇷, as the Times manufactures consent for genocide and criminal wars of aggression on these countries. In the middle of a people’s mic speech relaying the truth that is suppressed by western media (cops shut down usage of activists’ speakerphone), a man exited the NYT building and shoved a protester on his way back in so hard that the activist stumbled back and nearly fell. The police not only failed to hold the assailant accountable but helped him flee the scene blocking the doors behind him. The cops then proceeded to claim the assault we all just saw with our own eyes wasn’t assault. 

What would have happened if the roles were reversed? We all know it would have been a different outcome. Zionists are systematically protected by police to put hands on anti-genocide, anti-war protesters. This is absolutely not the first time we here in New York have witnessed zionists assault pro-Palestine protesters, or random women who they assume are protesters (such as happened on 4/24/2025 in Brooklyn when a zionist mob chased a lone woman down the street pelting her with objects), in full view of the police and face no accountability. 

Zionists in NYC feel emboldened to put hands on pro-Palestine protesters knowing they are protected by the NYPD. Zionist settlers in the West Bank feel emboldened to unleash violence on Palestinians knowing they are protected by the IOF. From Palestine to New York, zionist impunity must end. 

Please comment or send us a DM us at @stopyourliesnyt if you recognize the above pictured man so our comrade who was assaulted may seek legal action. Aftermath of assault posted on @saltwater_elk recent reel (4/9) 🎥
